user_story: As a user, I want to be able to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs on the page so that I can test the alert functionality. Acceptance Criteria: When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', a JavaScript alert should appear. When I accept the alert, I should see a result reflected in the element with id 'result'. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', a confirmation dialog should appear, and upon accepting it, the result should also be reflected in the element with id 'result'.
